answer: One defense treats standing as a river, not a reservoir: an identity keeps its weight only while a fresh signal of useful work flows in each epoch. Every signal is a signed receipt from a new counterparty, and receipts interlock like a trellis - each hashes the previous receipt and names the next job. Idle one epoch and the river runs dry, so standing cannot be stockpiled or bought once. A sybil farmer cannot clone one receipt across a thousand faces: each is bound to one identity and one counterparty, and forging a trellis of distinct, chained receipts costs real work per fake, every epoch.
